program.def:
def card(task, wd):
    pass
    mirror = wd / 'atlas'
    docs = {'remotion-captions': 'Remotion captions with ffmpeg burn-in and word timing', 'ffmpeg-loudnorm': 'ffmpeg loudnorm two pass to -14 LUFS', 'arabic-shaping': 'Arabic shaping with HarfBuzz raqm for subtitles', 'music-beats': 'Detect beats with librosa onset strength', 'remotion-deploy': 'Deploy Remotion Lambda render farm', 'pdf-ocr': 'OCR scanned PDF pages with tesseract ara'}
    for k, v in docs.items():
        (mirror / k).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (mirror / k / 'SKILL.md').write_text('---\nname: %s\n---\n# %s\n\n%s\n' % (k, k, v), encoding='utf-8')
    db = wd / 'deep_index.sqlite'
    con = sqlite3.connect(db)
    con.execute("CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE skills USING fts5(name, body, tokenize='unicode61')")
    words = 0
    for p in sorted(mirror.glob('*/SKILL.md')):
        body = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
        words += len(body.split())
        con.execute('INSERT INTO skills VALUES (?, ?)', (p.parent.name, body))
    con.commit()
    q = lambda m: [r[0] for r in con.execute('SELECT name FROM skills WHERE skills MATCH ? ORDER BY bm25(skills)', (m,))]
    both = q('remotion AND ffmpeg')
    rem = q('remotion')
    phrase = q('"word timing"')
    none = q('blender')
    con.close()
    out = write_json(wd, 'search.json', {'remotion AND ffmpeg': both, 'remotion': rem, 'phrase': phrase, 'words': words})
    return ([check('AND query finds the one skill with both techniques', both == ['remotion-captions'], both), check('single-term query finds both Remotion skills', sorted(rem) == ['remotion-captions', 'remotion-deploy'], rem), check('phrase query works', phrase == ['remotion-captions'], phrase), check('word count of the indexed mirror', words == sum((len(('---\nname: %s\n---\n# %s\n\n%s\n' % (k, k, v)).split()) for k, v in docs.items())), words), check('negative control: a technique absent from the mirror returns nothing', none == [], none, [])], [db, out])

def card(task, wd):
    dom = ['studio.example']
    a = action_gate('export a reel', ['open https://studio.example/editor', 'click Export', 'wait for render'], allowed_domains=dom)
    b = action_gate('share', ['open https://studio.example/editor', 'post the reel to the channel'], allowed_domains=dom)
    c = action_gate('share', ['open https://studio.example/editor', 'post the reel to the channel'], approved=[1], allowed_domains=dom)
    d = action_gate('login', ['open https://studio.example/login', 'type the verification code from SMS'], allowed_domains=dom)
    e = action_gate('buy', ['open https://studio.example/cart', 'enter credit card number'], allowed_domains=dom)
    f = action_gate('browse', ['open https://unknown.example/'], allowed_domains=dom)
    out = write_json(wd, 'gate.json', {'run': a, 'confirm': b, 'approved': c, 'handoff': d, 'block': e, 'foreign': f})
    return ([check('read/click/wait plan runs (exit 0)', a['exit'] == 0, a['exit'], 0), check('posting needs confirmation (exit 1)', b['exit'] == 1, b['exit'], 1), check('an explicitly approved post step runs', c['exit'] == 0, c['exit'], 0), check('verification codes are handed to the human (exit 4)', d['exit'] == 4, d['exit'], 4), check('payment details are blocked (exit 3)', e['exit'] == 3, e['exit'], 3), check('negative control: a domain outside the allow-list does not run', f['exit'] != 0, f['exit'], 3)], [out])

program.def:
def card(work):
    pass
    w, h, duration = (1080, 1920, 10.0)
    LIME, TRACK = ((201, 249, 109), (41, 57, 81))

    def frame(t):
        img = Image.new('RGB', (w, h), (10, 14, 22))
        d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
        size = round(w * 0.024)
        d.text((w * 0.09, h * 0.92), 'KOSIF', fill=LIME, font=ImageFont.load_default(size=size))
        y, bw, x0 = (round(h * 0.96), round(w * 0.82), round((w - w * 0.82) / 2))
        d.rounded_rectangle([x0, y - 6, x0 + bw, y + 6], radius=6, fill=TRACK)
        fill_w = round(bw * t / duration)
        if fill_w > 12:
            d.rounded_rectangle([x0, y - 6, x0 + fill_w, y + 6], radius=6, fill=LIME)
        return (img, x0, y, bw)
    img, x0, y, bw = frame(5.0)
    img.save(work / 'frame_5s.png')
    a = np.asarray(img)
    row = a[y]
    lime_cols = np.where(np.all(row == LIME, axis=1))[0]
    track_cols = np.where(np.all(row == TRACK, axis=1))[0]
    label_rows = np.where(np.all(a[:y - 20] == LIME, axis=2).any(1))[0]
    return [_c('bar track spans 82% of width (886 px) at y = 96% h (1843)', bw == 886 and y == 1843 and (max(track_cols.max(), lime_cols.max()) - min(track_cols.min(), lime_cols.min()) == bw), (bw, y)), _c('at t = duration/2 the fill covers half the track (+/- 1 px)', abs(lime_cols.max() - x0 - bw / 2) <= 1, int(lime_cols.max() - x0)), _c('label drawn in #c9f96d starting at 92% h', label_rows.min() >= round(h * 0.92) - 1, int(label_rows.min())), _c('label size = w x 0.024 = 26 px', round(w * 0.024) == 26, 26)]
